notes: servertick.c ports one world's tick with a parked or supplied player; serverreplay.c sr_tick_world wraps it with the tail steps (unload marks, portal forcer, villages) and the entity pass. servertick.c tick_updates keeps a 1000-entry array on the stack. hardcore difficulty forcing and BiomeCache.cleanupCache are not modelled (hardcore is not played; the cache is result-neutral). Which pieces the snapshot gates cover beyond the named recordings was not audited. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): non-chest block events change no server state (redstone off); getEntrancePortalLocation is ported under the End travel (end-arrival-s1); func_147477_a is redstone; setSpawnLocation() is the client call. Formerly listed as missing: the block event queue drain (func_147488_Z, func_147485_a), now world.c world_block_events_run for the chest events (lane/rlscenes). setSpawnLocation's air-column fuzz (used when a spawn point has no top block) has no native counterpart. func_147477_a (is a tick scheduled this tick) and func_147486_a (tile entities in a box) were not found natively. Oracle hook: getPendingBlockUpdates' first line hands a chunk save's call to netherite.oracle.PendingTicks (lane/replaylat).
